nalli:10347763499307.description: Ambara is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold zari, centred on the classic Manga motif. A contrasting silk border is traced with delicate manga detailing, while measured manga butas move across the body with graceful rhythm. The pallu unfolds into an intricate woven jaal, where silk and zari create a subtle interplay of richness and light.

nalli:10347763663147.description: Amudhai is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold and silver zari. A radiant broad gold tissue border is adorned with Mayilkann pet and Manga moggu detailing, while dual-tone Mayil butas glide across the body. Vintage Paisa motifs in the pleats and an expansive contrasting pallu complete this richly composed heirloom drape.

nalli:10347766448427.description: Arunima is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram handwoven with half-fine gold zari, distinguished by its Mubaggam three-part composition. Crafted in the rare Korvai four-shuttle weave, contrasting upper and lower panels are framed with cross-leaf Kamalam peths. Floral butas enrich the centre, while the pallu is finished with zari Ghetti bands and Vanki detailing.

nalli:10347766645035.description: Kolam is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold zari, inspired by the artistry of South Indian Kolam. A tone-on-tone jacquard body lends quiet depth, framed by a ghetti border with Kolam forms and zari Rudraksha butas. The pallu unveils the regal Gandaberunda motif amid brocade texture and luminous gold detailing.

nalli:10068560085291.description: This half-and-half saree blends tradition with modern craftsmanship. Crafted in crepe and organza, it’s elegantly finished with a gold band trim.

nalli:10068556284203.description: This green soft organza saree is inspired by traditional Indian chintz and features vibrant floral patterns in pink and coral tones. The design includes blooms like chrysanthemums and peonies, with intricate details and small pearl tassels, reflecting the rich textile artistry.

nalli:10068540064043.description: This saree, crafted in organza with a pearl trim, features a hand-painted design translated to digitally printed, hand illustrations. Inspired by Indian miniature art, it showcases a serene landscape of stylised trees, deer, peacocks, and birds, symbolising grace, intelligence, and peace with rich colours and intricate details.

nalli:10068538229035.description: Showcasing intricate floral arrangements inspired by classic French fabric—Toile de Jouy, delicately detailed with shimmering gold embroidery, this design is framed by a broad gold band, enhancing its timeless elegance. Crafted in organza with a digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features embroidery in the body for added richness.

nalli:10068379697451.description: Meet Akira, Tussar Saree from the Live Boldly collection by Nalli. Crafted to perfection, the body features horizontal stripes of gold zari spread all over the body and slowly seeping into the pallu. A beautiful three-inch border is traced by two golden zari lines running through it.

nalli:10068379107627.description: Meet Amisha from the Live Boldly collection. Crafted to perfection, its body features thin stripes every 1.5 inches, while the pallu showcases alternating stripes in contrasting widths. Saree edges have a 1.5-inch warp marking the borders, with finer stripes on the lower end extending 30 cm, blending smoothly into the main body pattern.

nalli:10059564777771.description: Meet the elegant 'Aahana' Mustard Tussar Saree from Nalli’s Live Boldly collection. The silver-blonde body features delicate zari check patterns, complemented by a tangerine pallu with golden zari stripes. A sleek tangerine border adds charm.

nalli:10071727833387.description: A muppagam saree, known for its three-part design, beautifully weaves together contrasting colours and patterns, making each drape a visual masterpiece. This muppagam saree features sacred mayil (peacock) motifs on its borders, inspired by Kanchipuram’s ancient lore. Delicate kamalam (lotus) butis grace the body, while a rich ghetti pallu enhances its timeless elegance.

nalli:10069207318827.description:
Handwoven in pure silk tissue, this saree embodies understated elegance with its luminous gold zari
motifs. The borders are adorned with muthu seeru, kamalam, and rudraksha, framed by the striking reverse thazhampoo reku. The pallu carries a story of heritage, featuring manga mokku, kamalam kattu, and the majestic gaja-yali and yanai, symbols of strength and prosperity.

nalli:10068027932971.description: This handwoven silk saree with gold zari reimagines muthu kattam through a diamond brocade. A broad border with thazhampoo reku motifs blends into the body. The pallu honors temple art with yanai and yaali for wisdom and protection, while the kamalam adds divine elegance and grace.

nalli:10049569554731.description: Inspired by Indian lore, the killi motif symbolizes love and wisdom. Paired parrots shine in green meenakari. A bold emerald border with chakram frames the saree. The pallu unites killi, chakram, and thazhampoo reku motifs, weaving a regal tapestry of tradition and elegance that captures timeless beauty.

nalli:10066750046507.description: The Tarangini Pure Kanchipuram Silk Saree from Nalli’s Shubhra collection embodies fluid grace with floral motifs and plant-inspired patterns. Its border features geometric lines and circular motifs, while the pallu showcases a stylized sprung trellis.
tags: Curated Nalli Silk Sarees ? Timeless Elegance

nalli:10064269312299.description: The Thamarai Pure Kanchipuram Silk Saree from Nalli’s Shubhra collection symbolizes grace and purity. Crafted from 100% pure silk, it features a half-and-half design with lotus motifs, diamond floral bands, and a chevron-floral creeper border. Handwoven using Jacquard weaving, it blends tradition with contemporary elegance.

nalli:10068562084139.description:
This half-and-half saree blends tradition with modern elegance. Gold half-tissue pleats offer subtle shimmer, while black Pure silk organza features spaced chintz florals. Delicate gold line art adds depth, enhancing the striking contrast of
bright blooms against the dark fabric for a refined and balanced look.

nalli:10068560970027.description: This half-and-half saree blends tradition with modern elegance. Gold half-tissue pleats offer subtle shimmer, while black organza features spaced chintz florals. Delicate gold line art adds depth, enhancing the striking contrast of bright blooms against the dark fabric for a refined and balanced look.

nalli:10068557693227.description: Inspired by traditional chintz, this saree features delicate leaves and classic florals in a seamless jaal, transitioning into sparse, fine blooms. A zari border and pallu tassels add sophistication, blending heritage craftsmanship with timelessness.

nalli:10068554613035.description: Crafted in organza with a pearl trim, this saree honours the heritage of Indian chintz textiles with intricate floral designs. The half-and-half style features a dense jaal on one side and delicate flowers on the other, reflecting the finesse of intricate hand paintings.

nalli:10068552909099.description: Crafted in Crepe, this saree features a vibrant, multi-colour print of hand-illustrated orchids and other flowers, capturing their delicate beauty and strength. The dynamic composition blends bold and soft shades, creating a harmonious and artistic arrangement that highlights each bloom's unique form and colour.

nalli:10068552024363.description: This saree, crafted in pure silk organza, captures the essence of cherry blossoms (Sakura) with elegant blooms flowing across the fabric. Symbolising life's impermanence, renewal, and beauty, the delicate flowers evoke the fleeting nature of spring and timelessness.

nalli:10068551369003.description: This saree, crafted in soft organza, features bold peony blooms against a striking coral orange backdrop. Revered in Greek mythology, China, and Japan, the peony symbolises wealth, bravery, honour, and good fortune, bringing a vibrant, dramatic essence to the design.

nalli:10068550680875.description: Crafted in shades of pink, this saree features hand-painted prints of lily flowers, gradually becoming denser near the border to form a defined pallu. Made from light, airy organza, it offers a soft, flowing drape perfect for summer while symbolising purity and innocence.

nalli:10068548518187.description: Inspired by the chrysanthemum, a symbol of longevity and beauty, this saree features a botanical jaal pattern on a teal backdrop with pops of pink. A textured fabric with a woven zari border adds elegance, ensuring a graceful drape that captures the flower’s timeless charm and cultural significance.

nalli:10068547240235.description: Crafted in cotton tissue, this saree is inspired by the iris symbol of hope, wisdom, and nobility as seen in Japanese floral art. Decorative florals bloom along diagonal bels, intensifying near the pallu for a serene flow. A woven zari border with extra weft work adds elegance, while digitally printed hand illustrations and a tasselled pallu create a look of depth, harmony, and grace.

nalli:10068545765675.description: This saree is inspired by traditional Pichwai art, showcasing Kamadhenu, the divine cow, with her calf as symbols of prosperity, purity, and abundance. Crafted in pure silk organza, it merges Indian mythology with contemporary art.

nalli:10068541374763.description: Inspired by florals in Indian miniature paintings, this saree features delicate, hand-painted flower prints with vibrant colours and intricate details. Made in cotton tissue with pearl lace, the design highlights the beauty and harmony of spring.

nalli:10068541079851.description: This design reflects the intricate beauty of Indian miniature paintings, with detailed trees set against a dark background for striking contrast. Fine linework adds depth, while vibrant colors enhance each tree’s charm. Crafted in pure silk organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. It features a gold beaded trim for an elegant finish.

nalli:10068540653867.description: This design reflects the intricate beauty of Indian miniature paintings, with detailed trees set against a dark background for striking contrast. Fine linework adds depth, while vibrant colors enhance each tree’s charm. Crafted in organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. It features a gold beaded trim for an elegant finish.

nalli:10068538917163.description:
Showcasing intricate floral arrangements inspired by classic French fabric—Toile de Jouy, delicately detailed with shimmering gold embroidery, this design is framed by a broad gold band, enhancing its timeless elegance. Crafted in pure silk
organza with a digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features embroidery in the body for added richness.

nalli:10068537671979.description: Inspired by the majestic allure of peacocks in Mughal art, this saree captures their regal charm and cultural depth. Digitally printed on luxurious organza, it features intricate embroidery and a sequins-embroidered trim. It pays tribute to India’s artistic legacy while exuding grandeur, beauty, and timeless grace.

nalli:10068537311531.description: Crafted from pure silk organza with delicate pearl-trimmed gold accents, this saree is a modern interpretation of the chinoiserie art style, featuring peacocks, parrots, and swallows amidst flowing trees and lush foliage. It captures the essence of a vibrant Indian forest with delicate flowers, evoking the spirit of summer and spring.

nalli:10068533510443.description: Inspired by daffodils and pressed flowers, this saree captures nostalgic beauty with clean white lines tracing delicate floral curves. Golden zari accents enhance contrast, while bold blooms on the pallu add drama. Crafted in organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features a gold beaded trim and zari embroidery in the pallu.

nalli:10068533084459.description:
Made from pure silk organza with a delicate pearl trim, this saree draws inspiration from Indian miniature paintings and French Toile de Jouy. Featuring hand-illustrated garden scenes with flowers and birds, it combines intricate artistry
and storytelling, offering a light, airy drape with timeless beauty and modern elegance.

nalli:10068532265259.description: Made from organza with a delicate pearl trim, this saree draws inspiration from Indian miniature paintings and French Toile de Jouy. Featuring hand-illustrated garden scenes with flowers and birds, it combines intricate artistry and storytelling, offering a light, airy drape with timeless beauty and modern elegance.

nalli:10068381729067.description: Unveiling the "Dusky Diva" Bhagalpuri Plain Tussar Saree from Nalli's Yours Truly collection, celebrating minimalistic elegance for the modern season. Handwoven using traditional thigh-reeled yarn on a fly loom shuttle, it offers a silk-like texture and easy drape. The body has zari stripes, the border features temple motifs, and the pallu displays solid hues with zari accents.

nalli:10068381172011.description: Presenting the 'Metallic Magenta' Bhagalpuri Tussar Saree from the Yours Truly collection. A blend of tradition and minimalism, its metallic sheen adds modern elegance. Handwoven using thigh-reeled yarn on a fly shuttle loom, it features zari checks on the body, a plain border, and a pallu with intricate zari bands. Lightweight and breathable, perfect for stylish workwear.

nalli:10066828230955.description: Introducing Orchid Dream from the Yours Truly Collection. In a soft orchid hue, this Bhagalpuri Tussar saree blends grace and elegance. Handwoven with thigh-reeled yarn and extra weft, it features seamless stripes across the body, border, and pallu. Lightweight and breathable, it’s ideal for workwear with a touch of refined style.

nalli:10053276139819.description: Step into whimsy with our "Dance of Dragonfly" Tussar silk saree. Featuring dragonfly and floral motifs in an alternating pattern, it symbolizes life's fleeting beauty. A striped border and pallu add classic charm, while its lustrous drape ensures effortless elegance and joy.
tags: Elegant Tussar Sarees ? Designed by Nalli

nalli:10053274173739.description: Step into whimsy with our "Dance of Dragonfly" Tussar silk saree. Featuring dragonfly and floral motifs in an alternating pattern, it symbolizes life's fleeting beauty. A striped border and pallu add classic charm, while its lustrous drape ensures effortless elegance and joy.

nalli:10053262344491.description: Embrace timeless beauty with "Forget Me Not" by Nalli, a Tussar silk saree inspired by the delicate Myosotis creepers. Adorned with intricate creepers on the border and pallu, its soft, lustrous drape captures fleeting moments, celebrating memories, joy, and the essence of life.

nalli:10053221122347.description: Step into elegance with the Rosette Whimsy Bhagalpuri Tussar Saree from Nalli’s Yours Truly Collection. Featuring a plain body, zari-striped borders, and a temple motif pallu, it’s handwoven using traditional thigh-reeled yarn for a silk-like drape, merging comfort with timeless style.

nalli:10053220598059.description: The "Tropical Teal" Bhagalpuri Tussar Saree from Nalli’s Yours Truly Collection embodies tranquillity and renewal. Crafted using traditional thigh-reeled yarn on a fly shuttle loom, it features zari checks on the body, a plain border, and a lined pallu.

nalli:10296727372075.description: Titli, framed with proportioned stripes that gradually narrow towards the body, bringing together a vibrant palette in harmony. Where the border and pallu stripes meet, tiny checks appear, evoking abstract butterflies - delicate creatures of spring and summer. The plain body offers soft contrast, allowing the colours to shine. On the pallu, these stripes return as subtle checks, adding a light, balanced finish.

nalli:10296727306539.description: Aamras, named after the beloved summer indulgence, is a Bengal cotton saree woven in fine 60-count cotton. Clean horizontal stripes move in a gentle linear rhythm, while the pallu carries delicate zari, balanced by bright accent stripes. Its hues draw from the mango itself, shifting from tender green to ripened yellow. Light and breathable, Aamras is made for warm days and unhurried dressing.

nalli:10296727241003.description: Chhaya, our Bengal cotton saree, draws inspiration from the clean, modern lines of Piet Mondrian. A contrasting band forms the top border, creating a striking visual highlight across the body, while minimal stripes along the base and pallu introduce structure and balance. Bold colour blocks reinterpret Chhaya, meaning shadow in Hindi, and the solid pallu completes the look with contemporary ease.

nalli:10296726421803.description: Patang features fine multi-coloured checks woven using four harmonious hues, creating a lively yet balanced design. Translating to kite in Hindi, the saree reflects the light, easy spirit of a patang gliding across an open sky. The border and pallu are minimal, finished with delicate zari accents that add subtle richness. With its balanced play of colour, it makes for a breathable, comfortable drape.

nalli:10296725471531.description: Mishri, a celebration of summer in Bengal cotton, is woven in fine 60-count cotton and drapes with natural comfort. Soft stripes move in gentle linear patterns across the fabric, creating a lively yet balanced design. The fine checks they form are a gentle reminder of crystal sugar, lending the saree its name. Light, breathable, and effortlessly wearable for sunlit days.

nalli:10296725176619.description: Kuhu, named after the soft call of the koel that signals the arrival of summer, carries the same cheerful warmth in its colours. The palette brings together softer tones and brighter hues in a lively blend. Rendered in cotton, it features asymmetrical borders and subtle zari stripes across the body, while the pallu continues the stripe play, edged in delicate zari for a bright, balanced finish.

nalli:10296725078315.description: Mogra is designed to feel light and effortless. Its muted pastels draw from the soft, fragrant bloom of jasmine, mogra, giving the saree its name. Intentional colour-blocking lends it a distinct presence, while contrasting panels shape the pleats and pallu with quiet structure. Fine vertical stripes add subtle detail, and silver zari stripes on the pallu offer a gentle, radiant highlight.

nalli:10296725045547.description: Fiza, translating to breeze in Urdu, reflects a sense of gentle lightness in both colour and character. Inspired by the classic Kanjeevaram Muppagam, or three-part design, the saree is composed in three complementary sections. Horizontal stripes move across each panel, while the harmonious palette and breathable 60-count Bengal cotton make it ideal for warmer days. Fresh, balanced, and easy to wear.

nalli:10296724848939.description: Surahi, a name that evokes the earth and grounded beauty, carries a sense of calm poise in its design. Woven in fine cotton, it is framed by a striking zari border where gold and silver stripes meet a slender accent line, adding subtle distinction. Rich colour tones and a refined striped layout lend it quiet elegance, while a broad gold zari band completes the border with a distinct finish.
